notes: Page states the Fedders-Airwell serial styles are being used here, with the caveat: 'Although unconfirmed it is believed that all Fedders-Airwell brands including Emerson use these styles.' That unconfirmed-belief caveat applies to the style below (mirrors the shipped Airwell file, same page content). Page Style 1 is NOT shipped: it shares its shape (2 letters + 9 digits + 1 letter) with held page Style 3, so a Style 3 serial would mis-decode under Style 1 with a wrong week/year; shipping it would violate the never-guess rule. Page Styles 3, 4 and 5 are held for the image pass (month/year letters chart-only).

styles.notes: Page example shown as '02J-60002' (dash stripped by normalization). Year = 1st & 2nd characters (digits). Month = 3rd character letter per chart image FEDDERS-2-Serial-Number.jpg, held for the image pass, so year-only.
